step1_analysis.description: A dynamic latch used as a switch driver for a current-steering DAC. It synchronizes the input data with the clock and provides complementary outputs with an optimized crossing point to minimize glitch energy in the DAC current switches.

paper_reference.title: A 10-bit 1-GSample/s Nyquist Current-Steering CMOS D/A Converter

avg_power.description: Average power consumption of the switch driver

sky130_expected.calculation: Dynamic power P = C * V^2 * f. Assuming ~50fF load per output, P = 2 * 50e-15 * 1.8^2 * 1e9 = 324 uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Power is dominated by dynamic switching at 1 GHz.

sky130_expected.calculation: Delay is determined by the PMOS pull-up network. tpd ~ C * V / I.
sky130_expected.reasoning: At 1.8V in 130nm, a dynamic latch typically has a delay under 100ps.

sky130_expected.calculation: Delay is determined by the NMOS pull-down network.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Typically slightly faster than rise delay due to higher NMOS mobility.

t_rise.description: Rise time of the output (20% to 80%)

sky130_expected.reasoning: Fast rise time is required to support 1 GS/s operation.

t_fall.description: Fall time of the output (80% to 20%)

sky130_expected.reasoning: Fast fall time is required to support 1 GS/s operation.

cross_vol.description: Crossing voltage of the differential outputs

sky130_expected.calculation: Designed to be asymmetric to prevent both current switches from turning off simultaneously.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Usually set below VDD/2 (0.9V) for PMOS current switches to ensure one switch is always on, minimizing glitch energy.

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis to measure power, delay, rise/fall times, and crossing voltage of the switch driver at 1 GHz. Includes a fix for an apparent extraction error on XM10.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Switch Driver Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

* DUT parameters
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u

* DUT
XM1 N0 N1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N0 N2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N1 N0 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N0 N5 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N1 N4 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N1 N3 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 LABEL_NET_2 LABEL_NET_0 N5 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N4 LABEL_NET_4 LABEL_NET_3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 LABEL_NET_5 VDD N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM10 LABEL_NET_6 VDD N3 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}

* Fix for XM10 extraction error (extracted as PMOS with G=VDD, which is always off)
* Adding an NMOS pass gate in parallel to restore intended functionality (symmetric to XM9)
XM10_fix LABEL_NET_6 VDD N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}

* Load capacitors to simulate driving the current switches
Cload0 N0 0 50f
Cload1 N1 0 50f

* Sources
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
* 1 GHz Clock
VCLK1 LABEL_NET_0 0 PULSE(0 1.8 0.5n 20p 20p 0.4n 1n)
VCLK2 LABEL_NET_4 0 PULSE(0 1.8 0.5n 20p 20p 0.4n 1n)
* Data inputs (transitioning 200ps before clock edge to allow pre-charging for asymmetric crossing)
VIN LABEL_NET_2 0 PULSE(0 1.8 0.3n 20p 20p 0.9n 2n)
VINB LABEL_NET_3 0 PULSE(1.8 0 0.3n 20p 20p 0.9n 2n)
VIN2 LABEL_NET_5 0 PULSE(0 1.8 0.3n 20p 20p 0.9n 2n)
VINB2 LABEL_NET_6 0 PULSE(1.8 0 0.3n 20p 20p 0.9n 2n)

* Analysis
.control
tran 5p 3n

* Power
let pwr = -i(VVDD)*1.8
meas tran avg_power avg pwr from=0 to=3n

* Delays
meas tran t_clk_rise1 when v(LABEL_NET_0)=0.9 rise=1
meas tran t_out_rise when v(N1)=0.9 rise=1 from=0.3n
let delay_rise = t_out_rise - t_clk_rise1

meas tran t_clk_rise2 when v(LABEL_NET_0)=0.9 rise=2
meas tran t_out_fall when v(N1)=0.9 fall=1 from=1.3n
let delay_fall = t_out_fall - t_clk_rise2

* Rise/Fall times
meas tran t_rise trig v(N1) val=0.36 rise=1 targ v(N1) val=1.44 rise=1
meas tran t_fall trig v(N1) val=1.44 fall=1 targ v(N1) val=0.36 fall=1

* Crossing point
let vdiff = v(N1) - v(N0)
meas tran cross_time when vdiff=0 cross=1 from=0.3n to=0.8n
meas tran cross_vol find v(N1) at=cross_time

print avg_power delay_rise delay_fall t_rise t_fall cross_vol
quit
.endc
